meta_description:
lakshmisharath on October 6, 2026: "I went to Gangotri with prayers and stood before Ganga Maa at Gangotri Dham, grateful to be there at last. But my journey also led me into village homes, local legends and friendships. ❤️

Village Ways invited me to experience Rural Stays Gangotri, an initiative supported by UNDP and implemented with local communities.

In Jhala, I stayed in a cosy little homestay overlooking the river. Over Pahadi meals and late-night conversations, my young hostesses, Jyoti and Khushi, became friends.

In Purali, we stepped into an old wooden house shared by four generations and nearly thirty family members. Chanda Devi’s stories made me linger, while the women showed us their handmade crafts.

With Dhiraj, we followed old pilgrim trails beside the river, wandered through apple orchards and heard legends of village temples.

And then came Selku—a centuries-old local festival. Dressed in Garhwali attire, I danced with the women and watched the Pashwa enter a trance.

Somewhere along the way, the little Pahadi girl within me came alive. I left a piece of my heart in these villages, with the people who had made me feel at home.

People make places.

Swipe through the journey.  Full travelogue on lakshmisharath.com

#Gangotri #Uttarakhand #RuralTourism #Selku #indiaonestoryatatime 

Would you add a village stay and experience on your next trip ?".
